# iptv-org-mcp - full reference

Curated free linear TV over the iptv-org static API (https://github.com/iptv-org).
No video stored or proxied. Upstream: Unlicense/CC0. This wrapper: MIT.

## MCP

Portmanteau tool `iptv(operation=...)`, 12 ops: help, status, refresh,
facets, search_channels, get_channel, search_streams, check_streams,
build_playlist, get_epg, jellyfin_setup, play_in_vlc. Second tool
`iptv_shutdown` (orderly exit, REST twin POST /api/shutdown).
Prompts: `evening_news(country)`, `match_night(sport, country)`.
Resource: `resource://iptv-org/legal`.
Tool annotations: readOnlyHint=false (mixed read/write), destructiveHint=false,
openWorldHint=true (upstream CDN). Output schema: {success, message, ...}.
Transports: stdio (Claude Desktop) + streamable HTTP at POST /mcp.

## REST (backend 11242, FastAPI)

- GET / (landing), /api/health, /api/capabilities, /api/tools (with portmanteau drill-down), /api/logs
- GET /api/playlists, /api/playlists/{name}.m3u (generated M3Us)
- GET /api/skills, /api/skills/{name} (iptv-operator)
- GET /api/iptv/facets, /api/iptv/search?q=&country=&category=
- GET /api/iptv/playlist?country=AT&category=&probe=&max_entries=
- GET /api/iptv/epg?channel_id=&query= ; GET /api/iptv/channel?channel_id=
- POST /api/iptv/play, POST /api/iptv/refresh
- GET /api/llm/discover, /api/llm/providers, /api/llm/models?provider=, /api/llm/onboarding
- GET /api/llm/ollama_state, /api/llm/gpus ; POST /api/llm/chat, POST /api/llm/chat/stream (SSE), POST /api/chat
- POST /api/shutdown (respond 200, exit ~500 ms later)
- Swagger /docs, ReDoc /redoc, schema /openapi.json

## Webapp (frontend 11241, React 19 + Vite 6 + Tailwind, dark zinc/amber)

Routes: /dashboard (hero + live KPIs + red onboarding cue), /channels (search/filter/sort/paginate/count,
grid-list toggle), /playlists (builder + copy URL + history), /guide (EPG lookup),
/inbox (refresh + artifacts), /tools (dynamic + drill-down), /chat (skill-first,
4 personalities, 6 examples, export .txt, 100-msg cap, localStorage),
/skills (server SKILL.md viewer), /api-docs (swagger/redoc iframe),
/logs (level + search), /settings (health + LLM provider/model/GPU), /help (6 tabs).
State: zustand store/llm.ts (keys llm_provider/llm_model/llm_gpu), lib/provider.ts
(resident-first pickPreferredModel, fitsTarget VRAM guard). testids on all controls.

## Workflow

facets -> search_channels -> build_playlist (probe=true for liveness) ->
VLC (paste M3U URL) or Jellyfin Live TV (M3U tuner + XMLTV from get_epg/jellyfin_setup).

## Config (env IPTV_ORG_MCP_)

host, port 11242, api_base, playlist_base, cache_ttl_hours 24, cache_dir ./data,
probe_timeout 8, probe_max 20, vlc_path. See docs/CONFIGURATION.md.

## Fleet

Ports 11241/11242 registered in WEBAPP_PORTS.md. Start: root start.ps1/start.bat,
web_sota/start.ps1 (dual-mode), starts mirror
mcp-central-docs/starts/iptv-org-mcp-start.bat. CI: ruff + pyright + pytest (backend),
biome + tsc + Playwright e2e (webapp). Session injection: .cursorrules,
.windsurfrules, .claude-plugin, copilot-instructions, .opencode + .agents skills.
